data.headline: TechnipFMC Awarded Subsea Contract For Coral North FLNG Development Offshore Mozambique; 'Substantial' Contract $250M-$500M
Piper Sandler Maintains Overweight on TechnipFMC, Raises Price Target to $52
data.summary: Piper Sandler  analyst Derek Podhaizer   maintains TechnipFMC (NYSE:FTI) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $49 to $52.

data.headline: Oil Falls To $55 And Energy Stocks Suffer Worst Day Since April
data.summary: Oil and gas stocks slid Tuesday as crude fell to $55 on rising Ukraine peace hopes, sending energy shares to their worst session since April.

data.headline: Shares of energy stocks are trading lower. Russia-Ukraine ceasefire hopes have pressured oil prices, while reports of warmer weather forecasts weigh on natural gas.
